# QS Top Universities

> > Global higher education resource providing QS World University Rankings, subject rankings, student city rankings, and comprehensive study abroad guidance.

QS Top Universities is the official platform for QS World University Rankings, offering detailed rankings across subjects, regions, and student cities. The site provides essential resources for international students including university comparisons, course guides, student profiles, and destination-specific study abroad information covering regions from Asia to Europe and the Americas.

## Key Topics

- QS World University Rankings
- Subject Rankings (Arts & Humanities, Engineering & Technology, Life Sciences & Medicine, Natural Sciences)
- QS Best Student Cities
- Study Abroad
- International Students
- University Comparison
- Higher Education
- Student Life
- Career Guidance
- Regional Rankings
- University Branch Campuses
- Gap Years
- Student Finance
- Course Selection

## University Rankings

- [QS World University Rankings 2026: Top Global Universities](https://www.topuniversities.com/world-university-rankings): Main QS World University Rankings 2026 with 6 key ranking indicators
- [QS World University Rankings for Arts and Humanities 2025](https://www.topuniversities.com/university-subject-rankings/arts-humanities): QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025 for Arts & Humanities
- [QS World University Rankings for Engineering and Technology 2025](https://www.topuniversities.com/university-subject-rankings/engineering-technology): QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025 for Engineering & Technology
- [QS World University Rankings for Life Sciences and Medicine 2025](https://www.topuniversities.com/university-subject-rankings/life-sciences-medicine): QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025 for Life Sciences & Medicine
- [QS World University Rankings for Natural Sciences 2025](https://www.topuniversities.com/university-subject-rankings/natural-sciences): QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025 for Natural Sciences
- [Northern Europe Rankings 2026](https://www.topuniversities.com/europe-university-rankings-northern-europe): QS Northern Europe regional university rankings 2026

## Student Cities & Destinations

- [Universities in Dublin - QS Best Student Cities Ranking](https://www.topuniversities.com/university-rankings-articles/qs-best-student-cities/dublin): Dublin's QS Best Student Cities ranking with Trinity College and indicators
- [Universities in Toulouse - QS Best Student Cities Ranking](https://www.topuniversities.com/university-rankings-articles/qs-best-student-cities/toulouse): Toulouse's QS Best Student Cities ranking with Université de Toulouse
- [Top 10 Things to Do in Japan](https://www.topuniversities.com/where-to-study/asia/japan/top-10-things-do-japan): Travel guide for students studying in Japan featuring Tokyo and Kyoto
- [Gap Years in Latin America](https://www.topuniversities.com/where-to-study/south-america/gap-years-latin-america): Gap year travel guide for Latin America including Mexico and Costa Rica

## Course & Career Guides

- [Careers in Interpreting and Translation](https://www.topuniversities.com/courses/modern-languages/careers-interpreting-translation): Career guide for interpretation/translation at UN, CIA, European Commission
- [Film Studies Dual Degrees](https://www.topuniversities.com/courses/performing-arts/film-studies-dual-degrees): Film studies dual degree programs including SOAS combinations
- [Media and Communication Studies: Global Relevance](https://www.topuniversities.com/courses/communication-media-studies/media-communication-studies-global-relevance): Global significance of media/communication degrees in social media era

## Student Life & Advice

- [University Branch Campuses](https://www.topuniversities.com/student-info/choosing-university/university-branch-campuses): Guide to international branch campuses like Nottingham and Paris Sorbonne
- [US Universities: Learn the Jargon](https://www.topuniversities.com/where-to-study/north-america/united-states/us-universities-learn-jargon): US university terminology guide for international students
- [Student Jobs: Pros and Cons](https://www.topuniversities.com/student-info/student-finance/student-jobs-pros-cons): Pros/cons analysis of working while studying by Kanika Tandon
- [ROAR! And Other Stress Relievers](https://www.topuniversities.com/blog/roar-other-stress-relievers): Student stress management tips for essays and exams by Laura Bridgestock

## Student Profiles & Experiences

- [Biology Graduate Degree in Sweden: Student Profile](https://www.topuniversities.com/where-to-study/europe/sweden/biology-graduate-degree-sweden-student-profile): Chinmaya Sadangi's biology graduate experience at Uppsala University
- [The Global Entrepreneurship Program](https://www.topuniversities.com/courses/business-management-studies/global-entrepreneurship-program): EMLYON, Purdue, Zhejiang joint entrepreneurship program graduate profile
